references.text: Abimelek divided his men into three groups and lay in ambush, which directly leads to the action in verse 44 where he himself took position at the city gate.
The continuation of the attack where Abimelek fought against the city all that day, captured it, and killed its people.
A similar military tactic involving an ambush and blocking of the city gate used by the Israelites against Benjamin at Gibeah.
Joshua used a similar ambush tactic against Ai, where soldiers waited in hiding and then attacked from both sides.
Saul also divided his people into three groups in battle against the Ammonites, a similar military strategy.
